name: Aperture by Tailscale
description: Routes LLM and MCP traffic from coding agents through a gateway in your Tailscale network, replacing shared API keys with tailnet identity and adding spending limits and logs.

skills.name: LLM Gateway
skills.description: Routes requests from LLM clients to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and other providers, injecting provider keys so users never handle shared API keys.

skills.name: MCP Server Proxying
skills.description: Aggregates tools and resources from remote MCP servers behind one /v1/mcp endpoint, with deny-by-default grants tied to Tailscale identity.

skills.name: Coding Agent Launcher
skills.description: Configures and launches coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode against the gateway with the alpha Aperture CLI.

skills.name: Tailnet Provisioning
skills.description: Joins a new application, service or machine to your tailnet through the built-in Tailnet connector, with an admin approving each new machine.

skills.name: Tailscale SSH Commands
skills.description: Discovers tailnet machines with Tailscale SSH enabled and runs shell commands on them through the built-in Tailscale SSH connector.
